test_title: PYST 14: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which two co-operative banks merged as per Reserve Bank of India's January 2025 notification?

options.text: Maratha Sahakari Bank and Janata Co-operative Bank
National Co-operative Bank and Cosmos Co-operative Bank
Saraswat Co-operative Bank and Cosmos Co-operative Bank
PMC Co-operative Bank and Cosmos Co-operative Bank

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Co-operative Bank and Cosmos Co-operative Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Reserve Bank of India** issued a notification in **January 2025** regarding the merger of **National Co-operative Bank** and **Cosmos Co-operative Bank**.
 
• The merger decision was based on the need to strengthen the **financial stability** of the co-operative banking sector and improve **operational efficiency**.
 
• **National Co-operative Bank** has a strong presence in the co-operative banking sector, primarily catering to urban and semi-urban areas.
 
• **Cosmos Co-operative Bank**, established in **1906**, is one of the oldest and largest co-operative banks in India, offering services like deposits, loans, and digital banking.
 
• The merger aims to leverage the combined resources and infrastructure to provide better services to customers and ensure enhanced **credit flow** to the priority sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Co-operative Bank:**

 
 
• Established to provide **banking services** to urban and semi-urban areas, focusing on co-operative principles.
 
• It specializes in catering to the needs of **small-scale industries**, traders, and individuals.
 
• Offers a range of services including **savings accounts, fixed deposits, loans, and financial advisory.**
 
 
 
• **Cosmos Co-operative Bank:**
 
 
• Founded in **1906**, Cosmos Co-operative Bank is headquartered in **Pune, Maharashtra**.
 
• It operates in more than **10 states** of India with a network of branches and ATMs.
 
• Provides services such as **retail banking, corporate banking, insurance, mutual funds, and digital banking solutions.**
 
 
 
• **Reserve Bank of India’s Role:**
 
 
• The RBI regulates co-operative banks under the **Banking Regulation Act, 1949**.
 
• Ensures financial stability by approving mergers and monitoring their implementation.
 
• Promotes consolidation in the co-operative banking sector to strengthen **capital adequacy** and operational efficiencies.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of Merging Co-operative Banks:**
 
 
• Improved **capital base** and resource allocation.
 
• Enhanced **customer service** through integrated infrastructure.
 
• Better compliance with **regulatory norms** and risk management practices.
 
• Increased ability to cater to **priority sectors** like agriculture and small businesses.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Co-operative Banking in India:**

 
 
• Co-operative banks are governed by both **state co-operative laws** and **RBI regulations**.
 
• They primarily cater to the financial needs of **rural and semi-urban areas**, focusing on **agriculture, small-scale industries, and self-employment.**
 
• Operate based on the principles of **mutual assistance** and co-operation.
 
 
 
• **Recent Mergers:**
 
 
• Several co-operative banks have merged in recent years to enhance their financial health and operational efficiencies.
 
• Example: **PMC Bank** merged with **Unity Small Finance Bank** in 2022.
